maddeler.e:
تستقذرون (form X)
# تَسْتَقْذِرُونَ (tastaqḏirūna) /tas.taq.ði.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# تُسْتَقْذَرُونَ (tustaqḏarūna) /tus.taq.ða.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
